title: After the Tryst
identity: James MacMillan, After the Tryst, for soprano saxophone or clarinet and piano, a 1995 saxophone version of the 1988 violin-and-piano work, edited/arranged by Gerard McChrystal. Boosey & Hawkes gives a 3-minute duration and the saxophone version’s premiere on July 7, 1995 by McChrystal.

evidence.claim: Boosey & Hawkes provides version instrumentation, 3-minute duration, saxophone premiere date/performer, and the composer’s account of its elongated, ornamented melody and simple arpeggiated piano chords.
Delphian album listing identifies McKenzie and Sawers as performers and identifies this as the first recording of the saxophone version.

review_focus: Inference: the composer’s description of elongated ornamentation over simple arpeggiated chords points to melodic shaping and coordination with sparse accompaniment as useful review questions.
collection_flag: Saxophone arrangement of a violin miniature; the publisher documents professional premiere and recording.

listening.description: McKenzie-Sawers Duo, Delphian DCD34201, listed as first recording of this version.
listening.verification: Recording credit verified; playback not auditioned.

gaps: Score not inspected; ornamentation, range, and exact technical demands remain unverified.
